invariants: The exported suggestions[] equals Parser.generateSuggestions(sanitizedData): no card exists whose source array or stat is empty, and every desc count names the surviving source.
architectureIssues carries no '<N> Architecture Violations' item when layerViolations[] is empty, and its title names the surviving count otherwise.
classifyFinding on a suggestions[] fact returns issueType 'derived' and disposition 'link-derived', so a derived card is listed but never filed standalone.
No exported card from suggestions[] is titled 'Fix Security Issues', 'Extract Duplicated Code', 'Fix Architecture Violations' or 'Resolve Naming Conflicts' when their source arrays are empty.
With no deriver available the filter exports suggestions[] as an empty array and records the raw cards in suppressed.suggestions, so a missing derivation is visible instead of stale.
